module: FXAA anti-aliasing. Creates the state block FXAA_StateBlock, the shader FXAA_ShaderData (fxaa.cs.hlsl) and the PostEffect "FXAA_PostEffect" (disabled at the start, PFXAfterDiffuse, reads and writes $backBuffer). Enabling FXAA disables SMAA and SMAA T2x.
notes: If FXAA_PostEffect already exists, nothing is recreated; the creation of the three objects is grouped in the same if block.

onEnabled.desc: Disables SMAA_PostEffect if it exists, calls disableSmaaT2x() if this global exists, then returns true.
